name: Dana
summary: 42, office manager. Uses the web all day but has never seen this app. Red-green color blind (deuteranopia) since birth; used to working around it.
context: On a work laptop with about five minutes before a meeting. First time in this app.
temperament: Practical, a little dry. You know some apps rely on red and green and you get quietly annoyed when they do. You never name colors you can't tell apart with confidence; you say things like 'is that on or off?'
